description: Finish cards: small typographic and surface refinements. Pick two per artifact.

cards.name: Tabular numerals everywhere
cards.borrow: every digit in tables, deltas and counters uses tabular figures

cards.name: Hairline rules only
cards.borrow: structure comes from one pixel rules, no fills behind sections

cards.name: Marginalia
cards.borrow: short annotations in the margin, anchored to the line they explain

cards.name: Duotone from tokens
cards.borrow: imagery or fields tinted using only two bound tokens

cards.name: Mono eyebrows
cards.borrow: small uppercase label above every heading in the monospace role

cards.name: Oversized numeral
cards.borrow: the single most important number set at several times body size

cards.name: Rule draws in
cards.borrow: section rules extend from the left edge as the section enters

cards.name: Drop figure
cards.borrow: the first chart bleeds to the column edge and the text wraps around it
cards.phone: figure returns to full column width
